controls.evidence_class: Synthetic transport/archive/ELF fixtures, mocked stage deadline, and one actual local sleeping-child process-group fixture

reviewed_boundaries: Exactly one added request file under the separate fixed prefix; four exact request fields; fixed operation/repository/ref/runner/UID1000/first-attempt checks
Pinned public asset URL and exact expected byte/hash identity; HTTPS only; fixed GitHub/release-assets origins; bounded redirects; no ambient proxy/auth/cookie forwarding
Critical response-header ambiguity rejection; exact content length; actual-body byte/hash checks; stage deadlines and no automatic retry
Signed redirect values and arbitrary exception messages are excluded from receipts; transport receipts contain origin/status/counters only
Compressed archive is reverified into immutable process-local bytes before bounded gzip decompression; tar is parsed only after the expanded-data ceiling
No extract/extractall, archive member execution, mode application, installer, root invocation, service/provider mutation, discovery symlink, or system Python change
Fixed-root member layout; duplicate/special/hardlink/setid rejection; ancestor-directory checks; bounded component-wise symlink resolution before parent traversal
Canonical Python executable is an AArch64 ELF of executable/shared-object type with the expected loader; dependency compatibility and license clearance remain unverified
The parent waits for the fixed worker to exit before reading its bounded regular receipt; no partial framed-pipe read remains
Workers remain in the outer controller process group; local cancellation fixture confirms group ownership and shutdown
Installation is prohibited in every success and failure receipt, and failed acquisition does not start inspection or retry

concrete_defects_fixed.before: Lexical normalization falsely accepted a target that escapes the python root when a preceding symlink is followed before '..'.
concrete_defects_fixed.after: Component-wise resolution rejects the same fixture with componentwise_link_escapes_python_tree.

concrete_defects_fixed.before: An ELF ET_REL object with an interpreter segment was accepted as the canonical Python executable.
concrete_defects_fixed.after: The same fixture is rejected with canonical_elf_not_executable; the canonical executable requires ET_EXEC or ET_DYN.

original_vs_corrected_proof.case_count_overlap: The two proof scenarios are already represented within the final 23 controls, not additional product cases.
original_vs_corrected_proof.historical_test_snapshot_note: The original proof binds the earlier 22-control test snapshot. The final test adds a serialization-observation control without changing those fixture constructors.

serialization_test_clarification.description: The reviewed 68723992 source already delays symlink emission until actual resolution. A production JsonLines callback now verifies serialized resolved_target values, closing the previous list-append reference-retention blind spot.

unresolved_gates: No actual candidate archive has been downloaded or statically inspected.
Publisher expected metadata is not a locally measured archive/executable/license identity.
Native transfer and process behavior on the OCI host remain unrun.
Native dependency compatibility, complete license clearance, installation design and product acceptance remain separate gates.
This local package creates no remote definition, request, dispatch or installation authority.
